# Steam — repeated ambushes and language-switch outcomes

- Original source: [Se me repiten demasiado las misiones de asalto de carruaje o al recaudador de impuestos](https://steamcommunity.com/app/46560/discussions/0/598533015389451359/)
- Author / publication: shano95 and respondents; Steam Community.
- Language / date: Spanish; opened 2025-07-24, last reply 2026-07-10.
- Access: Full thread (opening and all 10 comments) retrieved directly
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Retrieved: 2026-09-09
- Archived copy: lookup failed (archive.org rate limit); not checked
- Format: header notes, original summary, then complete post-by-post notes (Steam discussion, not transcribed)

The opening asks whether repeated carriage and tax-collector ambushes are a bug. Nobutora associates one such blockage with the Spanish-language Robin rescue transition. Ignasozu reports that renaming language folders did not help, but subsequently confirms being able to continue after changing the language through Steam instead.

Later replies include an apparent loss of progress after switching languages and continuing requests for help. Those are reported outcomes, not proof of deleted save files or a universally effective fix. The thread is especially useful for distinguishing a Steam language change from merely renaming resource directories.

Facts usable for parity work: folder codes 3082 and 2047 are the language directories the poster renamed (3082 is the Windows locale id for Spanish (Spain), 2047 is the Windows locale id for German-neutral; that mapping is not stated in the thread); renaming them did not trigger the rescue mission, while changing the language through Steam properties did; the Robin rescue is expected right after the Lady Marian rescue mission; language change through Steam hides existing saves.
